snippet.title: Friendship Test - Full Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Friendship Test is a game that follows a friendprogram, a robot built to be a perfect friend, as they travel a mysterious lab and encounters multiple Programs in need of help (and friendship). But perhaps being the best friend you can be isn’t truly what FriendProgram wants… Is that so wrong?

Friendship Test is a 10+ hours RPG Maker game that focuses on lovelessness, aplatonicism, aromanticism and many other aspec identities, as well as neurodivergency. I have been working on this project for almost a year and I’m close to the finish line. 
You can play the demo on itch.io already! The full game will be released completely for free there as well:

https://mar64.itch.io/friendship-test-demo
